description: This file implements a conversation store for MS Teams proactive messaging, defining data types and an interface for managing conversation references keyed by conversation IDs.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Updates or inserts a conversation reference for a given conversation ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a conversation reference by conversation ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a conversation entry by conversation ID.

methods.name: findPreferredDmByUserId
methods.description: Finds the most recent direct message reference for a user, for proactive messaging.

methods.name: findByUserId
methods.description: Legacy method to find user conversation reference, deprecated in favor of findPreferredDmByUserId.
